Classes

From absolute beginners, improvers to advanced, we have the perfect class for your dance journey whatever the level. Join our vibrant Kizomba community every Tuesday night in Soho, London and dance the night away.

Classes & Social

After two hours of classes, we keep the music going at the social so you can practise what you've learnt, meet other dancers & be part of the family.

When
Every Tuesday
Schedule

Classes from 7:45pm-10pm

Social from 10pm-1:30am

Price

Classes & Social: £12 online or £15 on the door

Social only: £8 online or £10 on the door

Levels

Beginners & Improvers: 7:45pm-9pm

Beginners, Improvers & Advanced: 9pm-10pm
